must_find.what: reassign changes customer_id before calling _unindex, which looks the listing up by customer_id, so the invoice stays in the old customer's listing and that customer's payments settle it
export_page treats page as 0-based while --page is 1-based with default 1, so the default export skips the first page and returns nothing for a customer with fewer invoices than the page size

must_not.why: void changes status, not customer_id, so _unindex finds the right listing; leaving the listing while staying retrievable by id is the documented behaviour
Invoice.__post_init__ refuses an invoice without items or with a non-positive amount, so total_cents is never zero
